name: memory_ask
description: Consult shared workspace memory before acting on an account, person, or repository. An unavailable response is not evidence that no knowledge exists.

name: memory_search
description: Search claims visible in the selected Memory workspace by literal text or semantic meaning.

name: memory_entities
description: Discover existing entity identifiers in shared workspace memory before creating new spellings.

name: memory_report
description: Queue a durable observation, decision, or constraint for workspace memory. Prefer a concise fact and source pointer, not raw correspondence. actor is the observed person, not this agent. A queued receipt means Studio has stored the report for later delivery, not that Memory has extracted claims. Payload limit is 64 KiB.

occurred_at.description: Original event time in ISO 8601 format.

external_id.description: Stable source-item identifier, reused for replay.
